file_title: Q2 Compliance Participation Dashboard and Action Plan
introduction: This report provides an internal view of key compliance participation metrics and supporting controls for HelioFreight Logistics. It is intended to help Operations, HR, and site leaders maintain consistent adherence to corporate and regulatory expectations across North American locations. The document highlights current completion status, documentation practices, and near-term focus areas to reduce risk. Data reflects enterprise tracking through the end of the current reporting period.

subsections.heading: Quarterly Mandatory Training Status
subsections.content: During the March 2026 cycle, HR Operations finalized the instructor roster for 18 live sessions and reserved 420 seats across the Dallas, Chicago, and Toronto hubs. The LMS upgrade to v7.3 was completed on 03/22/2026 with a 99.6% system uptime target for Q2, and IT closed 27 helpdesk tickets related to single sign-on. Content owners in People Ops and Legal submitted 11 course revisions, primarily to align terminology with the updated Code of Conduct issued on 02/14/2026. Finance also renewed the enterprise learning vendor agreement through 12/31/2027 with a 3.1% rate increase and revised service-level credits.
subsections.justification: Focuses on scheduling and platform/vendor updates, not the tracked compliance activity; operational distractor.

subsections.heading: Audit Readiness and Documentation Controls
subsections.content: Internal Audit completed 6 walkthroughs between 01/08/2026 and 03/05/2026 covering billing, access provisioning, and warehouse inventory adjustments, with 14 minor control observations logged. The new document retention workflow in SharePoint requires dual approval for SOP changes and reduced uncontrolled document instances by 23% versus Q4 2025. In preparation for customer-led reviews, the Compliance PMO refreshed the evidence index for 9 sites and standardized naming conventions across 312 folders. Legal also updated the contract clause library on 02/28/2026 to reflect tighter data-processing addendum language for three enterprise shippers.
subsections.justification: Covers audit documentation controls and legal templates, not employee compliance tracking; documentation-process distractor.

subsections.heading: Operational Safety and Regulatory Updates
subsections.content: EHS issued a 03/12/2026 bulletin summarizing OSHA emphasis changes on powered industrial trucks and updated the pre-shift checklist used at 27 facilities. The network’s recordable incident rate decreased from 2.1 to 1.8 per 200,000 hours after deploying new dock lock maintenance intervals and refreshing yard pedestrian routes. Transportation Compliance circulated a DOT hours-of-service refresher memo for dispatch leads and updated the telematics exception thresholds on 03/18/2026. Facilities also completed 64 fire extinguisher inspections in February 2026 and replaced 19 units that failed pressure tolerance checks.
subsections.justification: Provides safety metrics and regulatory updates without identifying any tracked employee activity; operational-metrics distractor.

conclusion: The organization’s primary enterprise-wide compliance metric this quarter is the completion of the required Cybersecurity Awareness Training by all employees. Site leaders should review outstanding assignments weekly and ensure new hires are enrolled within established onboarding timelines. Compliance and HR will continue monitoring completion rates, issuing reminders, and escalating persistent gaps through standard management channels. Next steps include validating training records for audit readiness and aligning local communications to sustain timely completion across all facilities.
